foodie-old-town.title.en: Luohu Old Town Foodie Day Trip

foodie-old-town.bestFor.zh-Hans: 情侣 / 三五好友、吃货、想一次尝遍多款小吃
foodie-old-town.bestFor.en: Couples, small groups of friends, foodies, and anyone who wants to sample lots of different snacks in one go

foodie-old-town.tips.zh-Hans: 避开 12:00–14:00 和 18:00–20:00 两个高峰；东门小吃大多是一人份，建议 3–4 人分着吃，多点几款。
foodie-old-town.tips.en: Skip the two rush hours, 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:00. Most Dongmen street snacks come in single servings, so grab 3–4 friends and share a bunch of different ones.

foodie-old-town.stop0.name.zh-Hans: 东门老街 / 东门町美食街
foodie-old-town.stop0.name.en: Dongmen Old Street / Dongmen-cho Food Street（东门老街 / 东门町美食街）

foodie-old-town.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 老街牌坊、骑楼街景；东门町聚集牛杂、烤生蚝、肠粉、甜品等小吃
foodie-old-town.stop0.desc.en: Classic old-street archway and arcade-style shophouse views. Dongmen-cho is packed with snacks like beef offal, grilled oysters, rice noodle rolls, and sweet soups.

foodie-old-town.stop1.name.en: Xiangxi Village / Caiwuwei（向西村 / 蔡屋围）

foodie-old-town.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 潮汕砂锅粥、卤水拼盘、烧腊；本地人夜宵场
foodie-old-town.stop1.desc.en: Chaoshan clay-pot congee, braised meat platters and roast meats — a local late-night favourite.

foodie-old-town.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 饭后逛商场、买伴手礼（Ole' 超市）；地铁大剧院站直达
foodie-old-town.stop2.desc.en: Wander the mall after dinner and grab some souvenirs (Ole' supermarket) — right by Grand Theater Station（大剧院站）on the metro.

foodie-old-town.stop3.name.en: KK TIME / MixC Food Court（万象食家）

foodie-old-town.stop3.desc.zh-Hans: 新式餐饮楼层，可以当夜宵或甜品收尾
foodie-old-town.stop3.desc.en: A floor of modern eateries — great for a late-night bite or a sweet finish to the meal

art-coastal.title.zh-Hans: 蛇口文艺海滨慢行（半日）

art-coastal.bestFor.zh-Hans: 情侣、喜欢拍照和看设计展的朋友
art-coastal.bestFor.en: Couples, and anyone who loves taking photos and checking out design exhibitions

art-coastal.tips.zh-Hans: 建议下午 3 点后出发，看完展刚好赶上日落和海上世界音乐喷泉；喷泉一般 19:00–22:00 每半小时一场。
art-coastal.tips.en: Head out after 3 PM — you'll finish the exhibitions just in time for sunset and the Sea World musical fountain, which usually runs every half hour from 19:00–22:00.

art-coastal.stop0.name.zh-Hans: 海上世界文化艺术中心（设计互联）
art-coastal.stop0.name.en: Sea World Culture and Arts Center（海上世界文化艺术中心）

art-coastal.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 海景建筑、设计与当代艺术展、海景书店
art-coastal.stop0.desc.en: Seafront architecture, design and contemporary art shows, and a bookstore with ocean views

art-coastal.stop1.name.zh-Hans: 明华轮 / 海上世界广场
art-coastal.stop1.name.en: Minghua Ship / Sea World Plaza（明华轮 / 海上世界广场）

art-coastal.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 地标邮轮、喷泉表演、露天餐饮
art-coastal.stop1.desc.en: A landmark cruise ship, fountain shows, and open-air dining

art-coastal.stop2.name.zh-Hans: 蛇口渔街 / 海上世界美食街
art-coastal.stop2.name.en: Shekou Fishing Street / Sea World Food Street（蛇口渔街 / 海上世界美食街）

art-coastal.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 海鲜晚餐：砂锅粥、蒸海鲜、生蚝
art-coastal.stop2.desc.en: Seafood dinner: clay-pot congee, steamed seafood, and fresh oysters

art-coastal.stop3.name.zh-Hans: 蛇口邮轮母港 / K11 ECOAST
art-coastal.stop3.name.en: Shekou Cruise Homeport（蛇口邮轮母港）/ K11 ECOAST

art-coastal.stop3.desc.zh-Hans: 海滨散步与新商场（K11 ECOAST 一带）
art-coastal.stop3.desc.en: A seaside stroll and the new mall around K11 ECOAST

hakka-longgang.title.en: Longgang Hakka Old Town Day Trip

hakka-longgang.bestFor.zh-Hans: 想避开人潮、喜欢古村与客家菜的家庭、带长辈出行
hakka-longgang.bestFor.en: Great for families who want to dodge the crowds and love old villages and Hakka food, and for trips with elderly folks

hakka-longgang.tips.zh-Hans: 甘坑古镇街区免费、全天开放；地铁 10 号线甘坑站 B 出口步行约 15 分钟。个别场馆（二十四史书院、凤凰谷）另外收费。
hakka-longgang.tips.en: The Gankeng Old Town streets are free and open all day; it's about a 15-minute walk from Exit B of Gankeng Station（甘坑站）on Metro Line 10. A few venues (Twenty-Four Histories Academy, Phoenix Valley) charge separately.

hakka-longgang.stop0.name.zh-Hans: 甘坑客家小镇（甘坑古镇）
hakka-longgang.stop0.name.en: Gankeng Hakka Town（甘坑客家小镇）

hakka-longgang.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 客家围村、灯笼街、文创小店；国家 3A 级景区，街区免费
hakka-longgang.stop0.desc.en: Hakka walled villages, Lantern Street, and creative little shops; a national AAA-rated attraction with free street access

hakka-longgang.stop1.name.en: Gankeng Hakka Restaurant（甘坑客家菜餐厅）

hakka-longgang.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 盐焗鸡、客家酿豆腐、梅菜扣肉、窑鸡
hakka-longgang.stop1.desc.en: Salt-baked chicken, Hakka stuffed tofu, braised pork with preserved mustard greens, and clay-oven chicken

hakka-longgang.stop2.name.en: Dafen Oil Painting Village（大芬油画村）

hakka-longgang.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 油画街区、画廊，可定制画作；免费
hakka-longgang.stop2.desc.en: A whole district of oil-painting studios and galleries where you can order custom paintings; free

east-coast-dapeng.bestFor.zh-Hans: 喜欢海、想逃离市区的年轻人和家庭（建议自驾或报一日团）
east-coast-dapeng.bestFor.en: Young folks and families who love the sea and want to escape the city (self-drive or a day tour works best)

east-coast-dapeng.tips.zh-Hans: 路程远，回程容易堵车。地铁 2/8 号线已延伸至溪涌站（2025 年底通车），再换乘公交车进大鹏。较场尾沙滩有急流、没有救生员，千万别下水。
east-coast-dapeng.tips.en: It's a long way out and the trip back often hits traffic jams. Metro Lines 2/8 now reach Xichong Station (opened late 2025), where you can transfer to a bus into Dapeng. Jiaochangwei Beach has strong currents and no lifeguards—don't go in the water.

east-coast-dapeng.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 明清海防古城、将军府；免费
east-coast-dapeng.stop0.desc.en: A Ming-Qing coastal defense fortress with a general's residence; free

east-coast-dapeng.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 海边民宿群、沙滩日落；免费
east-coast-dapeng.stop1.desc.en: A cluster of seaside guesthouses with beach sunsets; free

east-coast-dapeng.stop2.name.en: Nan'ao Seafood / Yangmeikeng（南澳海鲜 / 杨梅坑）

east-coast-dapeng.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 南澳海鲜街；杨梅坑免费，可海滨骑行
east-coast-dapeng.stop2.desc.en: Nan'ao Seafood Street; Yangmeikeng is free and great for a coastal bike ride

east-coast-dapeng.stop3.name.zh-Hans: 盐田海鲜街 / 大小梅沙
east-coast-dapeng.stop3.name.en: Yantian Seafood Street (盐田海鲜街) / Dameisha & Xiaomeisha (大小梅沙)

east-coast-dapeng.stop3.desc.zh-Hans: 回程顺路的海鲜街与海滨公园
east-coast-dapeng.stop3.desc.en: A seafood street and seaside park that's right on your way back

halfday-futian-cbd.title.zh-Hans: 福田 CBD 半日：展览 + 商圈

halfday-futian-cbd.bestFor.zh-Hans: 从福田口岸过关、只有半天时间的旅客
halfday-futian-cbd.bestFor.en: Travelers crossing at Futian Port with just half a day to spare

halfday-futian-cbd.tips.zh-Hans: 深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆免门票、免预约，逢周一闭馆；旁边就是市民中心与莲花山公园。
halfday-futian-cbd.tips.en: The Museum of Contemporary Art & Urban Planning (深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆) is free with no booking needed, closed on Mondays; right next door are the Civic Center and Lianhuashan Park.

halfday-futian-cbd.stop0.name.zh-Hans: 深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆
halfday-futian-cbd.stop0.name.en: Shenzhen Museum of Contemporary Art & Urban Planning（深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆）

halfday-futian-cbd.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 免费常设展（城市规划、改革开放展）；周一闭馆
halfday-futian-cbd.stop0.desc.en: Free permanent exhibits (urban planning, Reform & Opening-Up); closed Mondays

halfday-futian-cbd.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 登顶看福田 CBD 天际线；免费
halfday-futian-cbd.stop1.desc.en: Head to the top for the Futian CBD skyline — free to enter

halfday-futian-cbd.stop2.name.en: COCO Park / Zhuoyue Center（卓悦中心）

halfday-futian-cbd.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 晚餐、天台酒吧、茑屋书店
halfday-futian-cbd.stop2.desc.en: Dinner, rooftop bars, and a Tsutaya bookstore

family-safari-park.tips.zh-Hans: 乐园门票提前网上买通常比现场便宜，而且可以免排队；记得带防晒、帽子、小孩水壶。1.2 米以下儿童多数乐园免费。
family-safari-park.tips.en: Buying park tickets online ahead of time is usually cheaper than at the gate and lets you skip the line. Bring sunscreen, hats, and a water bottle for the kids. Most parks are free for children under 1.2m.

family-safari-park.stop0.name.en: Shenzhen Safari Park（深圳野生动物园）

family-safari-park.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 放养式动物园，有海洋动物馆和游乐区；09:30–18:00
family-safari-park.stop0.desc.en: An open-range zoo with a marine animal house and play areas; 09:30–18:00

family-safari-park.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 海滨餐饮街 + 水舞灯光秀，适合午餐和傍晚散步
family-safari-park.stop1.desc.en: A waterfront dining strip with a fountain-and-light show — great for lunch and an evening stroll

family-safari-park.stop2.name.en: Shenzhen Talent Park（深圳人才公园）

family-safari-park.stop2.desc.zh-Hans: 看深圳湾夜景、看春笋大厦灯光，免费
family-safari-park.stop2.desc.en: Catch the Shenzhen Bay night views and the lights of the Spring Bamboo Tower — all free

family-happy-valley.title.zh-Hans: 华侨城亲子机动游戏日

family-happy-valley.bestFor.zh-Hans: 想玩机动游戏的家庭 / 青少年
family-happy-valley.bestFor.en: Families and teens who love theme park rides

family-happy-valley.tips.zh-Hans: 欢乐谷成人票约 ¥228、儿童及老人票约 ¥130；70 岁以上、1.2 米以下免费。夏天建议下午入场玩到夜场。
family-happy-valley.tips.en: Happy Valley adult tickets are around ¥228, kids and seniors around ¥130; free for ages 70+ and under 1.2m. In summer, head in around midday and stay for the night session.

family-happy-valley.stop0.desc.zh-Hans: 机动游戏 + 儿童专区 + 夜场表演
family-happy-valley.stop0.desc.en: Rides, a kids' zone, and evening shows

family-happy-valley.stop1.name.zh-Hans: 华侨城创意文化园 OCT-LOFT

family-happy-valley.stop1.desc.zh-Hans: 旧厂房文创街区，咖啡、书店、小店；免费
family-happy-valley.stop1.desc.en: An old-factory creative district with cafes, bookshops, and little stores — free to wander

0.name.en: Dongmen Old Street Snacks（东门老街小吃）

0.category.zh-Hans: 广式小吃 / 街头小吃

0.mustTry.en: beef offal, rice noodle rolls, grilled oysters, sweet soups

1.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖・蔡屋围 / 向西村

1.mustTry.en: fresh shrimp wonton noodles, roast goose, char siu

2.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖・向西村 / 福田・新村

2.mustTry.zh-Hans: 虾蟹砂锅粥、卤水拼盘、蚝仔烙
2.mustTry.en: shrimp & crab clay pot congee, braised meat platter, oyster omelette

3.area.zh-Hans: 福田・皇庭广场 / 罗湖・KK Mall
3.area.en: Futian · Hongtian Plaza（皇庭广场） / Luohu · KK Mall（KK Mall）

3.mustTry.zh-Hans: 狮头鹅卤水拼盘、鹅肠、普宁炸豆腐
3.mustTry.en: Marinated Chaoshan goose platter, goose intestine, and Puning fried tofu

4.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖 / 福田（口岸沿线）

4.mustTry.zh-Hans: 虾饺、金沙海虾红米肠、酥皮叉烧包
4.mustTry.en: Shrimp dumplings, golden-sand prawn red-rice rolls, and crispy BBQ pork buns

5.name.en: Shekou Sea World Seafood（蛇口海上世界海鲜）

5.mustTry.zh-Hans: 清蒸海鱼、椒盐海虾、生蚝
5.mustTry.en: Steamed fresh fish, salt-and-pepper prawns, and oysters

6.area.en: Longgang・Gankeng Ancient Town（龙岗・甘坑古镇）

6.mustTry.zh-Hans: 盐焗鸡、梅菜扣肉、客家酿豆腐、窑鸡
6.mustTry.en: Salt-baked chicken, braised pork with preserved mustard greens, Hakka stuffed tofu, and clay-oven chicken

7.area.zh-Hans: 龙岗 / 深圳东部围村
7.area.en: Longgang / walled villages in eastern Shenzhen

7.mustTry.zh-Hans: 围村盆菜（红焖猪肉、山珍层层叠）
7.mustTry.en: Walled Village Poon Choi (braised pork and layered mountain treasures)

9.name.en: Shajing Oysters / Nan'ao Abalone（沙井蚝 / 南澳鲍鱼）

9.area.zh-Hans: 宝安・沙井 / 大鹏・南澳
9.area.en: Bao'an · Shajing / Dapeng · Nan'ao（宝安・沙井 / 大鹏・南澳）

9.mustTry.zh-Hans: 炭烤生蚝、清蒸沙井蚝、盐焗鲍鱼
9.mustTry.en: Charcoal-grilled oysters, steamed Shajing oysters, salt-baked abalone

10.name.en: Coconut Chicken Hot Pot（椰子鸡火锅）

10.mustTry.en: Coconut chicken pot, bamboo fungus, Wenchang chicken

11.name.zh-Hans: 深圳夜市烧烤 / 夜宵
11.name.en: Shenzhen Night Market BBQ / Late-night Eats（深圳夜市烧烤 / 夜宵）

11.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖・东门 / 南山・海上世界
11.area.en: Luohu & Dongmen / Nanshan & Sea World (罗湖·东门 / 南山·海上世界)

11.mustTry.zh-Hans: 炭烤生蚝、烤鱿鱼、砂锅粥
11.mustTry.en: Charcoal-grilled oysters, grilled squid, and claypot congee

d-window-world.title.zh-Hans: 深圳世界之窗 门票 / 夜场票
d-window-world.title.en: Window of the World Shenzhen — Day & Night Tickets

d-window-world.merchant.en: Window of the World (深圳世界之窗)

d-window-world.summary.zh-Hans: 全天成人约 ¥220、夜场约 ¥120；1.2 米以下及 70 岁以上免费。线上提前买票通常比现场便宜。
d-window-world.summary.en: Full-day adult tickets are around ¥220, night tickets around ¥120. Free for kids under 1.2m and seniors over 70. Booking online ahead of time is usually cheaper than at the gate.

d-happy-valley.title.zh-Hans: 深圳欢乐谷 亲子 / 长者票
d-happy-valley.title.en: Happy Valley Shenzhen — Family & Senior Tickets

d-happy-valley.summary.zh-Hans: 成人约 ¥228、儿童及 60–70 岁长者约 ¥130；1.2 米以下及 70 岁以上免费。官方小程序买票免排队。
d-happy-valley.summary.en: Adult tickets are around ¥228, kids and seniors aged 60–70 around ¥130. Free for kids under 1.2m and seniors over 70. Buy through the official mini-program to skip the queue.

d-szoo.title.zh-Hans: 深圳野生动物园 家庭日

d-szoo.merchant.en: Shenzhen Safari Park (深圳野生动物园)

d-szoo.summary.en: ¥140 for kids (1.2–1.5m) and seniors aged 65–69, ¥190 for teens and students. Free for seniors over 70 and kids under 1.2m.

d-splendid-china.title.zh-Hans: 锦绣中华・中国民俗文化村
d-splendid-china.title.en: Splendid China & China Folk Culture Village (锦绣中华·中国民俗文化村)

d-splendid-china.summary.zh-Hans: 成人约 ¥220（线上常有 ¥210）；儿童 / 老人优待票约 ¥110；1.2 米以下及 70 岁以上免费。
d-splendid-china.summary.en: Adults around ¥220 (often ¥210 online); kids and senior concession tickets about ¥110; free for under 1.2m and over 70.

d-bay-glory-wheel.title.zh-Hans: 欢乐港湾「湾区之光」摩天轮
d-bay-glory-wheel.title.en: Bay Glory "Light of the Bay" Ferris Wheel（欢乐港湾湾区之光摩天轮）

d-bay-glory-wheel.summary.zh-Hans: 128 米海景摩天轮。平日 / 周末约 ¥150、节假日约 ¥180；1 米以下免费；10 人以上团体票约 ¥120/人。
d-bay-glory-wheel.summary.en: 128m seaview Ferris wheel. Weekdays/weekends around ¥150, holidays about ¥180; free for under 1m; group tickets for 10+ people about ¥120/person.

d-alipayhk-sz.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖 / 福田 / 南山

d-alipayhk-sz.summary.zh-Hans: 标有「Alipay+ 扫码领券」的商户扫码领券享立减；人民币交易自动以港币结算、免手续费。
d-alipayhk-sz.summary.en: Scan to grab vouchers for instant discounts at shops marked "Alipay+ scan for vouchers"; RMB transactions settle automatically in HKD with no fees.

d-wechatpayhk-sz.title.zh-Hans: WeChat Pay HK 港币直付 + 商场券
d-wechatpayhk-sz.title.en: WeChat Pay HK Direct HKD Payment + Mall Vouchers

d-wechatpayhk-sz.merchant.zh-Hans: WeChat Pay HK × 深圳商场

d-wechatpayhk-sz.area.zh-Hans: 福田 / 罗湖 / 南山

d-wechatpayhk-sz.summary.zh-Hans: 以港币钱包付款 0 手续费、自动汇率结算；合作商场常设满减券与交通券，深圳出租车也能用。
d-wechatpayhk-sz.summary.en: Pay with your HKD wallet at zero fees with automatic exchange-rate settlement; partner malls often offer spend-and-save and transit vouchers, and it works for Shenzhen taxis too.

d-unionpay-gba.title.zh-Hans: 银联 / 云闪付「玩赚大湾区」
d-unionpay-gba.title.en: UnionPay / QuickPass "Play & Earn in the Greater Bay Area"

d-unionpay-gba.summary.zh-Hans: 深圳地铁公交手机闪付半价（每笔最高减 ¥2）；港澳居民凭回乡证可登记「国补」享 15% 立减。
d-unionpay-gba.summary.en: Half-price on Shenzhen metro and buses when you pay by phone contactless (up to ¥2 off per ride). Hong Kong and Macau residents can register with their Home Return Permit to get the 15% national subsidy discount.

d-tax-refund.title.zh-Hans: 深圳离境退税（港人适用）
d-tax-refund.title.en: Shenzhen Departure Tax Refund (open to HK visitors)

d-tax-refund.merchant.zh-Hans: 深圳市财政局 / 税务局

d-tax-refund.area.zh-Hans: 罗湖 / 福田 / 深圳湾 / 机场

d-tax-refund.summary.zh-Hans: 同店同日满 ¥200 可退；13% 税率商品退 11%、9% 税率退 8%；离境日距购买日须 90 天内。
d-tax-refund.summary.en: Spend ¥200 or more at the same store on the same day to claim a refund. You get 11% back on 13%-taxed goods and 8% back on 9%-taxed goods. Just make sure you leave within 90 days of buying.

d-tourist-bus.title.zh-Hans: 深圳观光巴士（「红胖子」双层巴士）

d-tourist-bus.summary.zh-Hans: 4 条主题线可随上随下、任意换乘。24 小时票约 ¥50、48 小时套票约 ¥80、1.4 米以下免费。
d-tourist-bus.summary.en: Four themed routes with hop-on, hop-off and free transfers between them. A 24-hour ticket is around ¥50, a 48-hour pass around ¥80, and kids under 1.4m ride free.
